app.title: data-redacted
app.tagline: Redact spreadsheet columns without uploading anything

drop.title: Drop an Excel file here
drop.subtitle: or click to choose · .xlsx
drop.aria: Choose an Excel file to redact
drop.privacy: Your file is read in this browser tab and never sent anywhere. No upload, no server, no analytics — you can disconnect from the internet and this still works.
drop.wrongType: That does not look like an .xlsx file. Other formats are coming later.
drop.large: That is a large file. Everything still runs locally, but your browser may need a moment — and very large workbooks can exhaust the tab's memory.
drop.sample: or try it with a sample file

sheets.title: Which sheets hold data you need to redact?
sheets.scopeTitle: What goes into the downloaded file?

selected-only.label: Only the sheets I picked
selected-only.help: Everything else is left out of the download. Nothing you have not reviewed can travel with the file.

whole-workbook.label: The whole workbook, unpicked sheets unchanged
whole-workbook.help: Keeps the file structure intact, but sheets you did not review are copied across exactly as they are.

sheets.passThroughBody: These sheets go into the downloaded file exactly as they are now. Anyone you send it to will see their original contents:
sheets.passThroughTitle_one: {{count}} sheet will be copied without being redacted
sheets.passThroughTitle_other: {{count}} sheets will be copied without being redacted

header.title: Where are the column headers?
header.label: Header row in "{{sheet}}"
header.detected: Detected row {{n}} as the header, {{pct}}% confidence. Change it if that looks wrong.
header.inconclusive: Could not tell which row holds the headers — several rows look similar. Please pick the right one.

columns.title: What should happen to each column?
columns.lowCardinalityHelp: This column has only {{count}} distinct values, so hashing will not hide them — anyone can match the buckets back by counting how often each appears. Blank is the safer choice here.
columns.disclaimer: These are suggestions from pattern matching, not a guarantee. Check every column yourself — you are responsible for what ends up in the file.

preview.title: Check the result before you download
preview.empty: Nothing to preview yet — pick at least one column.
preview.footer: Showing {{count}} sample rows. The download covers every row.

export.title: Download
export.csvNote: CSV holds one sheet only — the first one you selected.
export.confirmPassThrough: Note: {{sheets}} will be copied through unredacted.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.generic: The file could not be processed. It may be corrupt or password-protected.
